name: LeviOptimize
description: A performance optimization mod for Minecraft Bedrock Dedicated Server and the Bedrock client

readmes.text: # LeviOptimize ![English](https://img.shields.io/badge/English-inactive?style=for-the-badge) [![中文](https://img.shields.io/badge/简体中文-informational?style=for-the-badge)](README.zh.md) LeviOptimize is a performance mod for Minecraft Bedrock Dedicated Server and the Bedrock client, built on [LeviLamina](https://github.com/LiteLDev/LeviLamina). It targets low server TPS by replacing hot native paths with cheaper ones: chunk publishing, entity broadcasts, redstone updates, locator labels, random ticks and async worker scheduling. Features are independent: each one has its own switch and can be enabled or disabled at runtime with `/lo`. ## Table of Contents - [Security](#security) - [Installation](#installation) - [Usage](#usage) - [Commands](#commands) - [Features](#features) - [Diagnostics](#diagnostics) - [Building from source](#building-from-source) - [Contributing](#contributing) - [License](#license) ## Security LeviOptimize is an independent project, not affiliated with or supported by Mojang or Microsoft. It is open source and free to use. Use it at your own risk; the authors are not liable for any damage to servers or data. ## Installation LeviOptimize requires LeviLamina 26.51.x. ### Using lip Install on a dedicated server with [lip](https://github.com/LiteLDev/lip): ```sh lip install github.com/LiteLDev/LeviOptimize ``` Install the client variant on the Bedrock client: ```sh lip install github.com/LiteLDev/LeviOptimize#client ``` ### Manual installation 1. Download the latest release from the [Releases page](https://github.com/LiteLDev/LeviOptimize/releases). 2. Unpack `LeviOptimize-server-windows-x64.zip` for a dedicated server or `LeviOptimize-client-windows-x64.zip` for a client. 3. Copy the `LeviOptimize` folder to `plugins/` on a dedicated server or `mods/` on a client. ## Usage On first start the mod writes `config.json` to `plugins/LeviOptimize/config/` on a server and `mods/LeviOptimize/config/` on a client. Each installation owns its own file. The config has a version and one object per feature section. A feature whose only option is the on/off switch is stored as a boolean; a feature with parameters uses an object: ```json { "version": 1, "features": { "chunk_leak_fix": true, "chunk_caches_opt": true, "push_entity_opt": { "enable": true, "disable_vec0_push": true, "max_push_times": -1, "unlimited_player_push": false } }, "commands": { "server_feature_manage_command": true, "client_feature_manage_command": true }, "diagnostics": { "full_frame_timing": true } } ``` - `features` holds performance features; - `commands` holds the command features themselves; - `diagnostics` holds measurement tools. Missing entries fall back to defaults, unknown sections and unknown feature entries are preserved when the file is written back, and `/lo reload` applies edits without restarting the server. ## Commands All command features are registered as regular features and can be turned off in `commands`. ### Server: `/lo` (GameDirectors) - `/lo list` — list every server feature with its running/config state; - `/lo triggers` — list registered triggers; - `/lo reload` — reload `config.json` and re-evaluate triggers; - `/lo reload ` — reload one feature's section; - `/lo enable ` / `/lo disable ` — change a feature's switch and persist it; - `/lo profile` — current and average full-frame MSPT/TPS from the `full_frame_timing` diagnostic. ### Client: `/clilo` The same actions for client features, using `Any` permission. The client command does not depend on server events. ## Features | Feature | Config key | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `ChunkCachesOpt` | `chunk_caches_opt` | Raises the chunk blending and chunk existence cache limits so dispersed players stop resetting them. Retains more memory. | | `ChunkLeakFix` | `chunk_leak_fix` | Removes disconnected players' map trackers, decorations and dirty state through the native cleanup. | | `CircuitSceneGraphOpt` | `circuit_scene_graph_opt` | Drops stale redstone power associations before a circuit update while keeping components that are still pending. | | `EntityPacketRecipientsOpt` | `entity_packet_recipients_opt` | Server-only entity broadcast: reads the actor ID once and batches recipients from each player's nearby actors. Falls back to the native path on invalid IDs. | | `LocatorOpt` | `locator_opt` | Caches the last sent locator position per viewer/observed pair and skips the native visibility check when nothing changed. | | `ParkedChunksOpt` | `parked_chunks_opt` | Holds publisher queue nodes that cannot be sent yet and rechecks them when chunks load or the view moves. | | `PlayerNetworkingOpt` | `player_networking_opt` | Rebuilds each chunk generation influence list once after the player networking pass instead of once per player. | | `PlayerSnapshotOpt` | `player_snapshot_opt` | Reuses a validated active-player snapshot for dimension iteration and active-player counts. | | `PushEntityOpt` | `push_entity_opt` | Optional entity-push limits: drop zero-vector pushes, cap pushes per tick, or leave player pushes unlimited. | | `RandomChunkOpt` | `random_chunk_opt` | Samples chunk keys for autosave instead of walking the chunk map every time. | | `RandomTickPrefetchOpt` | `random_tick_prefetch_opt` | Predicts vanilla random-tick storage reads and prefetches them without advancing the game RNG. | | `SeenPercentOpt` | `seen_percent_opt` | Caches seen-percent values per position and bounding box. | | `VanillaWaypointsOpt` | `vanilla_waypoints_opt` | Short-circuits locator waypoint updates when the tracked set and icon have not changed. | | `WorkerBacklogOpt` | `worker_backlog_opt` | Sets the async worker backlog delay from 0.05 s to zero after validating the target field. | ## Diagnostics `FullFrameTiming` (`full_frame_timing`, section `diagnostics`) is a measurement tool, not an optimization. It times the server update from `Minecraft::update` and splits catch-up ticks around `Level::tick`; `/lo profile` prints the last 20 samples. It can be disabled like any other feature. ## Building from source Requires [xmake](https://xmake.io) and an LLVM/clang-cl toolchain. ```sh # dedicated server xmake f -c -m release --target_type=server xmake # client xmake f -c -m release --target_type=client xmake ``` The packaged mod is written to `bin/LeviOptimize`. ## Contributing Issues, questions and pull requests are welcome. ## License GPL-3.0-or-later © LeviMC

# LeviOptimize [![English](https://img.shields.io/badge/English-informational?style=for-the-badge)](README.md) ![中文](https://img.shields.io/badge/简体中文-inactive?style=for-the-badge) LeviOptimize 是运行在 [LeviLamina](https://github.com/LiteLDev/LeviLamina) 上的 Minecraft 基岩版服务端 / 客户端性能模组。 它针对 TPS 偏低的热点原版路径做替换：区块发送、实体广播、红石更新、定位栏、随机刻和异步 worker 调度。 每个功能相互独立，都有自己的开关，可以在运行时用 `/lo` 启用或禁用。 ## 目录 - [安全性](#安全性) - [安装](#安装) - [使用](#使用) - [命令](#命令) - [功能](#功能) - [诊断](#诊断) - [从源码构建](#从源码构建) - [贡献](#贡献) - [许可证](#许可证) ## 安全性 LeviOptimize 是独立项目，不隶属于 Mojang 或 Microsoft，也不受其官方支持。项目开源且免费使用；请自行承担使用风险， 作者不对服务器或数据可能造成的损害负责。 ## 安装 LeviOptimize 需要 LeviLamina 26.51.x。 ### 使用 lip 在专用服务器上使用 [lip](https://github.com/LiteLDev/lip) 安装： ```sh lip install github.com/LiteLDev/LeviOptimize ``` 在基岩版客户端上安装 client 变体： ```sh lip install github.com/LiteLDev/LeviOptimize#client ``` ### 手动安装 1. 从[发布页面](https://github.com/LiteLDev/LeviOptimize/releases)下载最新版本； 2. 服务端解压 `LeviOptimize-server-windows-x64.zip`，客户端解压 `LeviOptimize-client-windows-x64.zip`； 3. 服务端复制 `LeviOptimize` 目录到 `plugins/`，客户端复制到 `mods/`。 ## 使用 首次启动时，模组会在服务端的 `plugins/LeviOptimize/config/` 或客户端的 `mods/LeviOptimize/config/` 生成 `config.json`。每个安装目录拥有自己的配置文件。 配置包含版本号和按功能分区的内容。只有开关的功能直接写布尔值；带参数的功能写成对象： ```json { "version": 1, "features": { "chunk_leak_fix": true, "chunk_caches_opt": true, "push_entity_opt": { "enable": true, "disable_vec0_push": true, "max_push_times": -1, "unlimited_player_push": false } }, "commands": { "server_feature_manage_command": true, "client_feature_manage_command": true }, "diagnostics": { "full_frame_timing": true } } ``` - `features`：性能功能； - `commands`：命令功能本身； - `diagnostics`：测量工具。 缺失条目按默认值处理，未知分区和未知功能条目在回写时原样保留；修改后执行 `/lo reload` 即可生效，无需重启服务端。 ## 命令 命令本身也是功能，可以在 `commands` 里关闭。 ### 服务端：`/lo`（GameDirectors） - `/lo list`：列出服务端功能及其运行 / 配置状态； - `/lo triggers`：列出已注册的触发器； - `/lo reload`：重新读取 `config.json` 并重新判断触发器； - `/lo reload `：只重载某个功能； - `/lo enable ` / `/lo disable `：切换功能开关并写回配置； - `/lo profile`：查看 `full_frame_timing` 诊断的当前 / 平均全帧 MSPT 与 TPS。 ### 客户端：`/clilo` 动作与服务端一致，权限为 `Any`。客户端命令不依赖服务端事件。 ## 功能 | 功能 | 配置键 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | `ChunkCachesOpt` | `chunk_caches_opt` | 提高区块混合 / 存在性缓存上限，避免玩家分散时反复清空缓存；会保留更多内存。 | | `ChunkLeakFix` | `chunk_leak_fix` | 玩家断线时通过原生清理移除地图 tracker、装饰和脏状态。 | | `CircuitSceneGraphOpt` | `circuit_scene_graph_opt` | 电路更新前清理失效的红石供电关联，保留仍待加入的组件。 | | `EntityPacketRecipientsOpt` | `entity_packet_recipients_opt` | 仅服务端：实体广播只读一次实体 ID，按玩家附近实体批量收集接收者；ID 无效时回退原生路径。 | | `LocatorOpt` | `locator_opt` | 按观察者 / 被观察玩家缓存上次发送的定位位置，没变化时跳过原生可见性判断。 | | `ParkedChunksOpt` | `parked_chunks_opt` | 暂存暂时发不出的 publisher 队列节点，在区块加载或视野变化时重新检查。 | | `PlayerNetworkingOpt` | `player_networking_opt` | 玩家网络处理结束后，每个区块生成优先级列表只重建一次，而不是每个玩家重建一次。 | | `PlayerSnapshotOpt` | `player_snapshot_opt` | 复用经过校验的活动玩家快照，加速维度遍历和人数统计。 | | `PushEntityOpt` | `push_entity_opt` | 可选的实体推动限制：关闭零向量推动、限制每 tick 推动次数、玩家相关推动不限次。 | | `RandomChunkOpt` | `random_chunk_opt` | 自动保存时对区块坐标采样，避免每次都遍历整个区块表。 | | `RandomTickPrefetchOpt` | `random_tick_prefetch_opt` | 预测原版随机刻要读的存储并预取，不推进游戏 RNG。 | | `SeenPercentOpt` | `seen_percent_opt` | 按坐标和包围盒缓存 SeenPercent 值。 | | `VanillaWaypointsOpt` | `vanilla_waypoints_opt` | 定位栏路标的跟踪集合和图标没变化时，直接跳过原生更新。 | | `WorkerBacklogOpt` | `worker_backlog_opt` | 校验目标字段后，把异步 worker 的积压等待从 0.05 秒设为零。 | ## 诊断 `FullFrameTiming`（`full_frame_timing`，位于 `diagnostics`）是测量工具，不是优化。它统计 `Minecraft::update` 的整帧时间，并用 `Level::tick` 切分补跑 tick；`/lo profile` 输出最近 20 个样本。 可以像其他功能一样关闭。 ## 从源码构建 需要 [xmake](https://xmake.io) 和 LLVM/clang-cl 工具链。 ```sh # 专用服务端 xmake f -c -m release --target_type=server xmake # 客户端 xmake f -c -m release --target_type=client xmake ``` 打包后的模组输出在 `bin/LeviOptimize`。 ## 贡献 欢迎提交 issue、提问和 PR。 ## 许可证 GPL-3.0-or-later © LeviMC
